inputs.style: Relentless death thrash metal, fast grinding alternate-picked guitars, pounding double-kick drums, low harsh intelligible male English vocal, raw distorted bass. 184 BPM, E minor. a rapid chromatic guitar figure; a stomping mid-song groove, chaotic solo and sudden ensemble stops. Raw heavily overdriven rhythm guitar amplifiers, forceful male English vocals. Complete 280-330 second song, extended developed guitar solo, riff variations, final chorus and decisive heavy ending.
inputs.lyrics:
[Verse]
Black ink on bone, the decree is cold
A throne built on the stories of the old
Torn from the jaw of the vanquished king
The law is sharp, the silence is the sting

[Chorus]
Empire of Teeth
Chewing the breath
Swallow the crown
Burn the ground

[Verse]
He bites the paper, he bites the pen
The marrow sings, a jagged hymn
Every statute is a molar's weight
Crushing the necks beneath the gate

[Chorus]
Empire of Teeth
Chewing the breath
Swallow the crown
Burn the ground

[Verse]
The incisor grows through the ribcage now
The molars grind against the brow
He tries to scream but the jaw is locked
Every law he made is choked
The teeth of the enemies bite back
Turning his flesh to a jagged track
The crown is just a nest of bone
A hive of pain on a stolen throne
He chews the air, he swallows dust
The empire rots from the inside out
The jaw unhinges, the face splits wide
The teeth are the only things that hide

[Bridge]
Stomp it down, crush the stone
The root breaks, the spine is lone

[Solo]

[Chorus]
Empire of Teeth
Chewing the breath
Swallow the crown
Burn the ground

[Chorus]
Empire of Teeth
Chewing the breath
Swallow the crown
Burn the ground

[Outro]
The crown snaps
The jaw drops
Empire of Teeth
